title: Recent Callbacks and the Finish Settlement — Calloway Limited Home Warranty Training Note
content:
*What do callbacks filed in the past year do to a finish-item cash settlement under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty?* They decide how the finish settlement is taken from the scheduled finish settlement.

**Rule.** How the finish settlement is taken from the scheduled finish settlement follows the callbacks filed on the coverage within the last 12 calendar months (dated later than the same calendar day 12 months before the settlement date): with two or more such callbacks the finish settlement is the program's cash-in-lieu maximum itself; with exactly one such callback it is the scheduled finish settlement plus half of the difference between the program's cash-in-lieu maximum and the scheduled finish settlement, rounded to the nearest cent; with no such callback it is the scheduled finish settlement.

**Questions answered by the rule.**

*Which callbacks count?* Every callback filed on the coverage in the window, whatever claim item it concerns.

*Where does the window begin?* Settled on 15 October 2025, the window takes callbacks dated 16 October 2024 or later; one dated 15 October 2024 is outside it.

*When is the one-callback figure rounded?* After the half of the difference is added to the scheduled finish settlement, to the nearest cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Cash-in-lieu maximum | Scheduled finish settlement | Callbacks in the window | Finish settlement |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 1000.00 | USD 517.50 | 0 | USD 517.50 |
| USD 1000.00 | USD 517.50 | 1 | 517.50 plus half of 482.50, which is USD 758.75 |
| USD 1000.00 | USD 517.50 | 2 | USD 1000.00 |
| USD 750.00 | USD 337.50 | 1 | 337.50 plus half of 412.50, which is USD 543.75 |
